title: personal-llm-inference-mini-tracker-zoe-2026-q1
content:
Mini tracker for quick local experiments and notes - informal

Goal: rapid comparisons of small inference knobs (quant, batch, kv-cache) to decide config for canary on dedicated pool. Not exhaustive, just quick numbers and signal.

Table: (copied from quick run outputs, roughly normalized)

Experiment | Model | Quant | Batch | SeqLen | Temp | Prompt variant | Throughput_tok_per_s | P95_latency_ms | Cost_per_1M_tok_est | Notes
---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---
exp-2026-02-05-a | llama2-13b | int8 | 8 | 512 | 0.2 | prompt-v1 | 7200 | 210 | $9.6 | stable, small drop in quality vs fp16
exp-2026-02-12-b | llama2-13b | q4_0 | 16 | 256 | 0.3 | prompt-v2 | 12400 | 150 | $6.4 | good perf, hallucination check needed on long context
exp-2026-02-20-c | mixtral-8x | int8 | 8 | 512 | 0.2 | prompt-v1 | 9800 | 180 | $8.2 | sharper outputs but higher cost
exp-2026-02-24-d | llama2-13b | q5_0 | 32 | 128 | 0.0 | prompt-v2 | 19500 | 95 | $4.1 | very low latency, artifacts at low temp, try with caching
exp-2026-02-28-e | llama2-13b | q5_0 + prefix-cache | 32 | 128 | 0.0 | prompt-v2 | 38000 | 60 | $2.1 | massive throughput improvement with KV prefix caching enabled

Quick notes:
- q5_0 looks promising for throughput/cost; must validate on safety/regression prompts (see linked confluence).
- Batch size tradeoff: beyond 32 diminishing returns on p95 for short seqs but throughput still increases; need to balance latency SLO.
- Prefix/KV caching huge win for repeat prefixes (chat-like). For single-turn few-shot prompt less benefit.
- Temp 0.0 reduces variability and token consumption slightly (fewer stop tokens) but affects creativity; for deterministic UX set 0.0-0.2.

Next steps / TODOs:
- [ ] Run full eval set (safety + quality) on q5_0 config (exp d/e) and compare to fp16 baseline
- [ ] Add measuring memory footprint (GPU mem) and OOM cases for batch>32
- [ ] Run on Dedicated staging pool (small canary) with traffic shaping to validate latency at scale
- [ ] Hook quick script output to console dashboard (per-route) for traceability

Commands / scripts (notes):
- run_local_benchmark.sh --model=llama2-13b --quant=q5_0 --batch=32 --seq=128 --prompt=prompt-v2
- collect_kv_cache_stats.py --logdir=/tmp/bench/2026-02-28-e

Open questions / things to check quickly:
- Is q5_0 deterministic across runs / different GPU drivers? (re-run multi-node)
- Are there any dequantization regressions on arithmetic / code-gen tests?
- Cost calc: using internal price sheet (linked) vs cloud list price — validate later with finance for Dedicated commitments.

Random notes to self (messy):
- Maya said try mixtral for code tasks, maybe a small bench on code/documentation generation next week.
- Remember to push results to confluence page + attach raw csvs.

Attached files (local): /tmp/bench/2026-02-28-e/results.csv (contains per-run latencies), /tmp/bench/2026-02-28-e/trace.log

End of mini-tracker entry
